confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak festival-season demand in Edinburgh, and rates vary widely by district and date. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer-to-drink relationship, not direct price knowledge.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against large historic European capitals with strong summer tourism and festival demand, adjusted to UK price levels. Prices were converted from approximate GBP levels at a rounded USD/GBP assumption, so the server's conversion will govern the final figures.
